short: Numbered tokens that tell customers when their order is ready.
seoTitle: Token System — Meaning and Example for Businesses
metaDescription: A token system issues a number with each order and calls or displays it when the order is ready. Both slow service more than the kitchen does.
definition: A token system issues a number with each order and calls or displays it when the order is ready. It is standard in quick service restaurants, food courts and pharmacy counters.
bodyHtml:
Why Token System matters

Tokens remove crowding at the counter and the constant interruption of customers asking whether their order is ready. Both slow service more than the kitchen does.

How Token System works in practice

Display the token prominently, keep the sequence visible, and show an approximate wait where possible. Crowds form when people cannot see progress, not merely when they are waiting.

faq.question: Do I need a display screen for tokens?
faq.answer: It helps at volume. A printed token and a called number work perfectly well at smaller counters.

faq.question: How is a token different from a queue system?
faq.answer: A token orders the service sequence; a queue system also manages waiting, estimates and notifications.
